pullRequests.body:
Upstreams OpenRAC's local changes to this repository (games/rac1/pal-patches/ in OpenRAC#371), so OpenRAC can drop them once its pin moves past this. One commit per patch, rebased onto current main (b4a462a). All five applied without conflicts.

commits.headline: feat: upstream OpenRAC's local changes (#240)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
* feat(tools): run the tools from inside OpenRAC

OpenRAC builds this tree as a subdirectory of its own repository
(games/rac1 on its develop branch, games/rac1/pal since it became a
submodule). The tools now find OpenRAC's top as the nearest parent
directory with games/rac1/game.json, at any depth, instead of a fixed
path:

- tools/docker/run.sh mounts all of OpenRAC, so its shared editor/,
  baserom/ and toolchains/ are visible in the container.
